Questions

What organizers want to know.

Do we have to buy inventory upfront? +
No. There’s nothing to buy upfront and no unsold inventory to worry about. Supporters order online during your campaign. After the deadline, we produce the coffee and ship the orders together to your school or organization. You promote the fundraiser; we handle the coffee.
How much can our group earn? +
Groups typically earn about $5–$6 per bag sold. That’s an estimated $500–$600 for 100 bags, $1,250–$1,500 for 250 bags, or $2,500–$3,000 for 500 bags. Actual proceeds depend on your campaign’s final pricing and costs, so these examples are estimates rather than guarantees.
Can the bag feature our school or team? +
Yes! We create a custom coffee label using your organization’s logo and branding. Whether you’re a school, PTO, booster club, sports team, or other organization, your coffee gets a look that’s personal to your community and gives supporters something special to buy.
What kind of coffee are we selling? +
One smooth medium roast in ground coffee. Keeping the offer focused makes it easy to explain, easy to promote, and simple for supporters to choose. No giant catalog or overwhelming list of products.
How are orders delivered? +
We ship the orders together to your school or organization after the campaign closes. Your group receives the coffee in one coordinated shipment, ready to distribute to supporters. You won’t need to manage individual customer shipments.
How much work is this for our organizers? +
The main job is sharing your fundraiser link with your community. Supporters place their orders online during the campaign, so you don’t have to collect order forms or purchase and store inventory. After the deadline, we coordinate production and ship the orders to your organization for distribution.
